mapper.select: select count(1) from club_member where status = 'ACTIVE'
select status as name, count(1) as value from activity group by status order by value desc
select status as name, count(1) as value from club_member group by status order by value desc

select date_format(stat_minute, '%H:%i') as bucket, total_count as total, error_count, avg_duration_ms from api_access_minute_stat where stat_minute >= date_sub(now(), interval #{minutes} minute) order by stat_minute

select concat(method, ' ', path) as name, sum(total_count) as value, concat(round(sum(avg_duration_ms * total_count) / nullif(sum(total_count), 0)), ' ms avg') as detail, null as rate from api_path_hour_stat where stat_hour >= date_sub(now(), interval #{hours} hour) group by method, path order by value desc limit #{size}

select concat(method, ' ', path) as name, round(sum(avg_duration_ms * total_count) / nullif(sum(total_count), 0)) as value, concat(sum(total_count), ' calls') as detail, null as rate from api_path_hour_stat where stat_hour >= date_sub(now(), interval #{hours} hour) group by method, path having sum(total_count) >= 1 order by value desc limit #{size}

select concat(method, ' ', path) as name, sum(error_count) as value, concat('last ', max(max_status_code)) as detail, null as rate from api_path_hour_stat where stat_hour >= date_sub(now(), interval #{hours} hour) and error_count > 0 group by method, path order by value desc limit #{size}

select title as name, greatest(registered_count, ( select count(1) from activity_registration ar where ar.activity_id = activity.id and ar.status = 'REGISTERED' )) as value, cast(capacity as char) as detail, case when capacity = 0 then 0 else round(greatest(registered_count, ( select count(1) from activity_registration ar where ar.activity_id = activity.id and ar.status = 'REGISTERED' )) / capacity * 100, 2) end as rate from activity order by rate desc, value desc limit #{size}

select name, greatest(claimed_count, ( select count(1) from user_coupon uc where uc.batch_id = coupon_batch.id )) as value, cast(stock as char) as detail, case when stock = 0 then 0 else round(greatest(claimed_count, ( select count(1) from user_coupon uc where uc.batch_id = coupon_batch.id )) / stock * 100, 2) end as rate from coupon_batch order by rate desc, value desc limit #{size}

select coalesce(max(username), concat('#', user_id)) as name, sum(total_count) as value, concat(count(distinct stat_date), ' active days') as detail, null as rate from user_activity_day_stat where stat_date >= date_sub(current_date, interval #{days} day) group by user_id order by value desc limit #{size}
select id, method, path, status_code, duration_ms, user_id, username, ip_address, created_at from api_access_log order by id desc limit #{size}
select id, user_id, username, method, path, action, status_code, duration_ms, ip_address, created_at from operation_log order by id desc limit #{size}
mapper.insert: insert into api_access_minute_stat ( stat_minute, total_count, error_count, avg_duration_ms ) select str_to_date(date_format(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as stat_minute, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when status_code >= 400 then 1 else 0 end) as error_count, round(avg(duration_ms)) as avg_duration_ms from api_access_log where created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval #{hours} hour) group by str_to_date(date_format(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') on duplicate key update total_count = values(total_count), error_count = values(error_count), avg_duration_ms = values(avg_duration_ms)

insert into api_path_hour_stat ( stat_hour, method, path, total_count, error_count, avg_duration_ms, max_status_code ) select str_to_date(date_format(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as stat_hour, method, path, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when status_code >= 400 then 1 else 0 end) as error_count, round(avg(duration_ms)) as avg_duration_ms, max(status_code) as max_status_code from api_access_log where created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval #{hours} hour) group by str_to_date(date_format(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), method, path on duplicate key update total_count = values(total_count), error_count = values(error_count), avg_duration_ms = values(avg_duration_ms), max_status_code = values(max_status_code)

insert into user_activity_day_stat ( stat_date, user_id, username, total_count, operation_count ) select date(created_at) as stat_date, user_id, max(username) as username, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when method not in ('GET', 'OPTIONS') and status_code < 400 then 1 else 0 end) as operation_count from api_access_log where created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) and user_id is not null group by date(created_at), user_id on duplicate key update username = values(username), total_count = values(total_count), operation_count = values(operation_count)
mapper.delete: delete from api_access_minute_stat where stat_minute < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
delete from api_path_hour_stat where stat_hour < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
delete from user_activity_day_stat where stat_date < date_sub(current_date, interval #{days} day)
delete from api_access_log where created_at < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
delete from operation_log where created_at < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
